mechanism_claims.claim_text: Plitidepsin antiviral activity against SARS-CoV-2 is mediated through inhibition of host eEF1A.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct target evidence is pharmacological/genetic resistance and knockdown/rescue evidence; the paper does not provide a new plitidepsin structural sequence table.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-of-addition and RNA/protein readouts support a post-entry cytoplasmic replication/translation-stage antiviral effect.

direct_assay_types: Western blot N protein time course
mechanism_claims.limitations: This claim supports stage/process context and is not used as standalone proof of direct molecular binding.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Mouse-model experiments support in vivo antiviral efficacy and reduced lung inflammation after plitidepsin treatment.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: BALB/c human ACE2 adenovirus and K18-hACE2 mouse SARS-CoV-2 models
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo efficacy is recorded as context, not as an AMP sequence/identity proof.
